title: Presheaf Čech vanishing implies derived cohomology vanishing
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a Grothendieck site and $F$ an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Suppose that for every map $f:P\to Q$ of presheaves of sets whose values lie in the universe of $F$, the complex $\check C^\bullet(f,F)$ [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex] has zero cohomology in each positive degree. Then $H^q(U,F)=0$ for every $U\in\mathcal C$ and $q>0$, where $H^q(U,F)$ is Mathlib Sheaf.H', equivalently Ext from the sheafified free abelian representable. HasSheafify and HasExt are assumed as in that definition. The site need not have pullbacks and its object and morphism universes need not agree.

source.place: Tags 03F9 and 079Z; presheaf-nerve vanishing variant using Yoneda extensions and the first-quadrant descent spectral sequence

proof.text: Strongly induct on n, simultaneously for every v-small presheaf P, to prove that Ext^n(Z[P],F) is a subsingleton for n>0. For any x choose a locally surjective f:E -> P killing x by the local-killing theorem.

Apply the presheaf Cech edge injection to f in degree n. The strong induction hypotheses supply vanishing of every lower positive Ext row, and hcech supplies vanishing of degree-n Cech cohomology. Injectivity and the zero pullback of x imply x=0, since Ext precomposition sends zero to zero. This proves the induction; n=1 has no lower positive degrees.

Take P=yoneda.obj U. Mathlib's H' F q U is definitionally the additive group on Ext^q(Z[P],F). The induction gives subsingletonness, and AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton gives the required IsZero.

proof_origin.place: Original Tags 03F9 and 079Z route, with local killing and edge injectivity separated as named intermediate theorems; strong induction and representable specialization written in Lean by U3.
